payload.instructions: Select the most likely primary effect of the drift.

questions.scenario: A health insurance plan currently has moderate deductibles and broad provider access.
questions.drift: The insurer lowers deductibles substantially while keeping premiums unchanged.
questions.prompt: What is the most likely immediate behavioral or risk effect?

solution.text: Lower deductibles reduce cost-sharing, increasing the likelihood that insured individuals consume more care than they otherwise would. This reflects a classic moral hazard effect.
